business_problem: As ServiceNow grew, separate IT and security processes created alert overload, weak prioritization, duplicated compliance evidence, and too much manual work across patching, incident response, and risk assessments.
solution_summary: ServiceNow consolidated IT, security, and risk on the ServiceNow AI Platform so every team works from the same operational context. Security Operations became the incident and vulnerability layer, while the Configuration Management Database serves as the shared source of truth for systems, assets, and business services. That common model lets IT and security rank and route work from the same data instead of passing tickets between separate tools. AI Agents and Now Assist then automate server-patch scheduling, investigation documentation, phishing triage, and post-incident reporting directly inside those workflows. Integrated Risk Management extends the same platform into policy, compliance, and audit operations for more than a dozen control teams, while AI Control Tower adds visibility and oversight for enterprise AI usage so governance is built into the operating model instead of bolted on later.

solution_components.name: ServiceNow AI Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the shared system where IT, security, and risk teams operate on common workflows and data.

solution_components.name: Security Operations
solution_components.role: Runs security incident, vulnerability, and phishing-response workflows on the platform.

solution_components.name: Configuration Management Database
solution_components.role: Stores the shared asset and service context used to prioritize and coordinate remediation work.

solution_components.name: AI Agents
solution_components.role: Automate repetitive patching, triage, and remediation tasks across IT and SecOps.

solution_components.name: Now Assist
solution_components.role: Drafts resolution notes, recommended actions, and post-incident reports for analysts.

solution_components.name: Integrated Risk Management
solution_components.role: Gives compliance teams a continuous, real-time view of controls, certifications, and audit readiness.

solution_components.name: AI Control Tower
solution_components.role: Provides oversight into where AI is used and whether deployments align with policy and risk standards.

data_flow: Asset and business-service context is maintained in the Configuration Management Database, then shared with Security Operations and IT workflows so both teams prioritize the same risks. AI Agents and Now Assist execute or document remediation, while Integrated Risk Management and AI Control Tower consume the same platform data to govern controls, audits, and AI usage.
business_outcome: ServiceNow increased server patch productivity by more than 50%, cut time to close security incidents by 85%, reduced manual work in risk assessments by 67%, resolved over half of false-positive phishing cases in under 20 seconds, and reclaimed more than 1,700 analyst hours each month.

evidence_quotes: Today, IT and security operate side-by-side on the ServiceNow AI Platform, sharing data, workflows, and insights to detect and respond to risk as a tag-team.
Both teams now share a single source of truth-the Configuration Management Database (CMDB)-which provides shared context across systems, assets, and business services.
AI Agents and Now Assist serve as the connective intelligence across this ecosystem.
Over a dozen compliance teams across the organization-from legal and privacy to security-use IRM to monitor controls, certifications, and audit readiness directly within the platform.
Automation and AI-driven playbooks have reclaimed more than 1,700 hours each month, allowing security teams to focus on higher-value response and prevention.
